aboutText: For over 35 years, Remarkable Landscapes has been Briar Hill's trusted landscaper, starting with swimming pool design in the late 70's and evolving into a full-service outdoor specialist. We handle all work in-house, including carpentry, stonemasonry, paving, earthmoving, water features, and planting. Our commitment to innovative design and expert craftsmanship consistently surpasses client expectations.
